entries.headline: PIRATE • Bandaid Radio logged on 6945 kHz
entries.summary: HF Underground listeners reported music and a Bandaid Radio identification in USB on 26 November UTC. Reception varied considerably across North America; no Australian reception is established.

entries.headline: PIRATE • Liquid Radio heard on 6945 kHz AM
entries.summary: A North American pirate listening thread records Liquid Radio at 0147 UTC on 25 November. This is a past reception report, not a regular broadcast schedule.

entries.headline: PIRATE • Five-week survey reveals popular pirate frequencies
entries.summary: A study of 282 North American pirate reception logs found that 233 clustered on ten frequencies in the 43-metre band. USB accounted for 68.1% of the logs; AM accounted for 31.2%.

entries.headline: CLANDESTINE • Uncertain signal near Iran International channel
entries.summary: Glenn Hauser reported a very weak carrier near 15730 kHz, a listed Iran International shortwave channel. He could not establish whether the signal was the broadcaster or interference from a jammer.

entries.headline: MILITARY HF • Noble Skywave international radio exercise
entries.summary: The US Army reported on the completed October international HF competition, hosted by the Canadian Armed Forces. Participants tested long-distance voice and data communications as alternatives to satellite-dependent systems.

entries.headline: ATSB brief describes runway collision at Whitsunday Coast Airport
entries.summary: A brief released on 27 November describes a light aircraft striking a runway inspection vehicle while landing at Proserpine on 8 August. No injuries were reported. The ATSB did not investigate the occurrence or independently verify the information it received.

entries.headline: Gold Coast Airport schedules three overnight closures
entries.summary: Airservices says both runways and the taxiways are scheduled to close for pavement and lighting works on the nights of 14, 15 and 16 December. Each closure is planned from 10:30 pm to 5:30 am the following morning, Queensland time.

entries.headline: Southern aviation HF area to split in March
entries.summary: Airservices Australia says it will split the Southern Flightwatch region into South Western and South Eastern areas on 1 March 2027 so it can manage them separately. Both areas will keep the same published shortwave channels: 3461, 6565 and 8822 kHz on upper sideband. The notice’s February effective date is separate from the March switchover.

entries.headline: ATSB investigating Sydney Airport go-around
entries.summary: A Qantas 737 went around at Sydney Airport on 25 November before it was cleared to land, after its crew reported seeing an Air New Zealand A321 crossing the runway. No one was injured. The ATSB is collecting evidence and has not released findings.

entries.headline: ATSB reports on Ocean Grove helicopter water landing
entries.summary: Three people were seriously injured when a sightseeing helicopter landed hard in shallow water in May 2025. The final report found that rotor speed likely fell below the target range during the descent and did not recover. The operator has updated its passenger safety briefing.

entries.headline: ATSB explains Darwin beach forced landing
entries.summary: A Cessna 207 lost engine power in June and landed on a beach near Darwin. The final report found that an improperly sealed fuel cap almost certainly let fuel escape. No one was injured.

entries.headline: CASA withdraws seven Australian-only Beechcraft directives
entries.summary: The change removes Australian-only inspection and replacement intervals for wing attachment hardware on certain Beechcraft aircraft. CASA says operators are still responsible for keeping that hardware airworthy and checking other applicable directives and manufacturer instructions.

entries.headline: Updated aviation charts take effect across Australia
entries.summary: Airservices’ November chart update includes changes to Sydney’s controlled airspace and adds Western Sydney International’s tower frequency to several route charts. The changes took effect on 26 November local time.

entries.headline: Western Sydney gets daily nonstop flights to Singapore
entries.summary: Singapore Airlines began flying daily between Changi and Western Sydney International on 23 November. The new service joins Air New Zealand’s existing Auckland route at the airport.

entries.headline: Melbourne runway incident prompts a review of works guidance
entries.summary: A Boeing 737 freighter abandoned take-off in February after a safety vehicle entered an active runway. The final ATSB report found that temporary cues did not clearly distinguish the active crossing during works. CASA plans to amend its guidance.

entries.headline: Gold Coast landing report highlights runway visibility
entries.summary: A 737 landed beyond the touchdown zone during a 2023 thunderstorm. The ATSB says visibility of the markings was likely reduced and is encouraging airports to consider reflective materials on runways used at night.
